rows.grounds: numeral element forming a compound number with the following word
locative plural indicating the large number in which the location is counted
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device), locative plural indicating location
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: What vast multitude of womb-mechanisms subjects beings to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The specific referent of the tormented beings is implied from context rather than stated explicitly in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
